title: Robot says hello · Level 1: One visitor
brief: Flash the light once in the garage, drive 3 squares to the visitor's yellow mat, stop and flash again, then go back into the garage. A flash is the light on for at least 1 s with the robot standing still. 60 s. 50 for ending in the garage with every flash made, up to 40 for speed, 10 for touching no wall. Par: 12 s.

score.run: round(if(visitedInOrder == 2 & endX >= gx0 & endX <= gx1 & endY >= gy0 & endY <= gy1, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)), 0) + if(touches == 0, 10, 0), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.visitedInOrder == 2 & r.endX >= gx0 & r.endX <= gx1 & r.endY >= gy0 & r.endY <= gy1)

sources.where: G1.1 Hello, robot, Challenge — Robot says hello: the field, the level table (level 1), the scoring paragraph; "How a run is measured" (the G1 run's end, stopped, the flash)
